policies: We DO NOT refund you your money if you cancel your rental.
If you cancel less than 24 hours before your rental, there will be no refund of your rental.
In case of a no-show at the time of rental, you will be charged a cancellation fee of 100% of the total rental cost.
If you cancel day of your rental you will STILL BE CHARGED.
STORM POLICY If it is raining/storming at the time of your rental, you will be granted a rain check.
You will NOT receive a refund, you will ONLY receive store credit.
We do not cancel reservations due to rain, we will ONLY cancel due to thunderstorms or high winds.
